Here is a formal transcription of the primary passenger manifest document shown in **image_86a2fe.png**.

### Header Information

* **Form No:** 659 B / Department of Commerce and Labor / IMMIGRATION SERVICE
* **Number:** 7
* **S.S.:** Cameronia
* **Sailing from:** Glasgow, 31st August 1912
* **Arriving at Port of New York:** 3rd Septbr, 1912
* **Page/Line Number:** 171 / 91

---

### Notation & Marginalia Transcriptions

* **Over Lines 23–28 (Large diagonal administrative stamp/handwriting):**
> *No. 1-6422*
> *Inspected*
> *No. 10 - remanifested on Sheet 8 - #11 as an alien*
> *by Insp. Macatee*


* **Large Bold Crayon Markings:** `V.C.`, `2-1`, `25 Cert`, `1 Alien`
* **Bottom Footer Warning:**
> IMPORTANT NOTICE.—Great care should be taken not to place on this list the name of any passenger who was not born in the United States or who has not taken out final naturalization papers. Failure to observe the terms of this notice may result in delay to the passenger at the port of arrival.Here is a detailed transcription of the specific columns visible in **image_864c85.png**, which focuses on the birth and naturalization details from the same 1912 passenger manifest.
